description: This PHP class 'DuplicateInfoFileValidator' is part of Drupal's package_manager module. It validates that there are no duplicate info.yml files in the staging directory that are not present in the active directory, ensuring no duplicate extensions are installed during deployment.

classes.name: DuplicateInfoFileValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing EventSubscriberInterface that validates for duplicate info.yml files in Drupal's package management staging process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with a PathLocator instance.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation to check for duplicate info.yml files between active and staging directories.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this class subscribes to, specifically the PreApplyEvent.

methods.name: findInfoFiles
methods.description: Recursively scans directories for info.yml files across modules, themes, profiles, and theme engines, returning a count of files by filename.
